linux.post_install:
api="https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/paper" version="$(curl -fsSL "$api" | python3 -c 'import json, sys; groups = json.load(sys.stdin)["versions"]; print(next(iter(groups.values()))[0])')" build="$(curl -fsSL "$api/versions/$version" | python3 -c 'import json, sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["builds"][0])')" url="$(curl -fsSL "$api/versions/$version/builds/$build" | python3 -c 'import json, sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["downloads"]["server:default"]["url"])')" curl -fL --retry 3 -o paper.jar "$url"
# Lets the agent start java, xvfb-run or env first (see the start line). printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec "$@"\n' > "./gse_start.sh" chmod +x "./gse_start.sh"
